title: Drone Mission Governance
dek: ProjectWyvern, the autonomy plane I built to sit between the people who approve drone missions and the drone's own flight controller. It checks a mission before take-off, then flies it while a safety guard watches telemetry. This page rebuilds that logic and tests which faults end a flight.
summary: Drone mission software, rebuilt and checked against the original: some telemetry faults bring the drone home, but losing telemetry is only logged and the flight goes on.
